critique: The carried-over material-blending flaw is gone: in the ISO/TOP render the white banks, black ROM, brass multiplier and copper op21 gates now all read distinctly against the blue floorplan plate, and the four grey standoffs in FRONT/SIDE anchor the plate to the die so nothing floats. The two residual defects were (1) the four standoffs at ±1.4 sat inside the 3.4-wide heatsink base and clipped through the fin stack, a visible interpenetration, and (2) the compact_bf_v2 dataflow was under-modelled — the pre-multiplier operand mux, the add-path halving-select mux, and the PWM double-pass feedback all lived only in spec notes, so the exploded datapath under-sold the reference's control structure. Both are now fixed; the silhouette still reads instantly as an HBM-flanked FPGA accelerator card with an exploded logic floorplan.
changelog: Shrunk the heatsink base to 2.9 m and fins to 2.7 m and moved the four standoff risers out to ±1.5 (inside the 3.2 m die, outside the heatsink) so the risers no longer interpenetrate the cold plate / fin stack
Added v_mux — the pre-multiplier A-operand select (v for NTT, v−u for INTT) — as a distinct steel mux, rewiring v_dff→v_mux→kred_mult to depict the '[mux sel] before modular_mul' of compact_bf_v2
Added add_mux — the INTT add-path output select that forwards op21(u+v) from mod_half_b during INTT — as a distinct steel mux driving the bank writeback

Added pwm_feedback, a thin copper return spine from kred_csub back into v_mux, making the PWM double-pass mode (stored 81^-1 = 11227 re-using the single K-RED unit) a visible feedback path instead of only an FSM note
Extended assembly_instructions to name the two operand/add muxes and the PWM return bus in build order
